narrative.intro: Fluor Intercontinental obligated $279M in FY2026 to date. Fluor Intercontinental received 13 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $21.5M, and obligations are up 89.2% year over year. Fluor Intercontinental’s recent fiscal-year obligations show a peak in FY22 at $313M, a drop to $34.6M in FY23, recovery to $142M in FY24 and $148M in FY25, and the current FY26 total of $279M. Fluor Intercontinental’s primary NAICS market in FY2026 to date is Facilities Support Services, accounting for $279M. Fluor Intercontinental also has recorded activity in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $500 and has an entry for All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $0. Fluor Intercontinental’s fiscal-year totals for FY2026 are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals. Fluor Intercontinental’s award-value tables and expiring-contracts tables, where present, show total contract values rather than obligations.
